import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
R,G,B = im[...,0], im[...,1], im[...,2]

# Classify into rough material labels
labels = np.zeros(im.shape[:2], dtype=np.uint8)
labels[(R>110)&(G<80)&(B<80)] = 1          # red
labels[(B>120)&(R<90)] = 2                 # blue
labels[(R>150)&(G>150)&(B>150)] = 3        # light/white-ish
labels[(R<70)&(G<70)&(B<70)] = 4           # dark
n, cc = ndimage.label(labels>0)
for i in range(1, n+1):
    m = cc==i
    lab = labels[m][0]
    ys,xs = np.where(m)
    if m.sum() < 15: continue
    mean = im[m].mean(0).round(1)
    print(f'comp{i} label{lab} n={m.sum()} bbox x[{xs.min()},{xs.max()}] y[{ys.min()},{ys.max()}] mean={mean}')
EOF"

im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
def cls(px):
    r,g,b = px
    if r>110 and g<80 and b<80: return 'R'
    if b>120 and r<90 and g<170:
        return 'B' if r<60 else 'b'   # B pure blue, b cyan
    if r>150 and g>150 and b>150: return 'W'
    if r<70 and g<70 and b<70: return '#'
    if abs(int(r)-int(g))<18 and abs(int(g)-int(b))<18:
        return '.' if r>=80 else ','
    return '?'
